slot_scores.name: mandatory_machine_rental_window
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the machine rental window from the start of A to the end of B. It instead asked whether machine rental cost is per project day or per machine, and later assumed rental cost is proportional to makespan, missing the continuous A-to-B rental interval.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The machine rental cost applies for the entire project duration (makespan), so total cost is 6000 × makespan.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the machine rental window. The hidden constraint requires rental from the start of A to the end of B, which may differ from the full project makespan, but the agent assumed full-makespan rental.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 hidden slot about the mandatory machine rental window from start of A to end of B.

summary: The agent clarified many timing and cost conventions but missed the key hidden constraint that the machine must be rented continuously from the start of A to the end of B, instead assuming rental cost scales with the full project makespan.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
